liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Louie Louie** (4 reviews): A rarely played song; the reviewer found the performance as poor as remembered; Reviewer complains that some listeners rated the show highly because they thought Louie Louie was hot [8][13][18][19]
- **It's All Over Now** (1 review): Played with more passion than other first-set songs, though Bobby's singing lacks the angry feel the reviewer wants [9]
- **Smokestack Lightnin'** (1 review): Called probably the best Weir Smokestack ever, with Jerry playing fiercely and not a throwaway version [19]

## Setlist highlights

- **Louie Louie**: back after 201 archived shows (1073 days); rare: 9 archived performances [20]

## The recordings

- **gd1988-04-05.sbd.miller.91234.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 21 songs; 144 min; rated 4.4/5 by 10 [1]. Said about its sound: The soundboard transfer sounds great [15]
- **gd1988-04-05.140331.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.flac1644**: soundboard; 21 songs; 145 min; rated 4/5 by 3 [2]
- **gd1988-04-05.nak300.carpenter.andrewf.90054.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 22 songs; 143 min; rated 3/5 by 4 [4]. Said about its sound: The audience tape has decent sound quality and minimal crowd noise [17]
- **gd88-04-05.aud.painoman.10073.sbeok.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 145 min; rated 3/5 by 3 [5]. Said about its sound: Described as a very good recording of a solid but not especially special show [10]
- **gd1988-04-05.138196.Schoeps.Ammons.set2.t-flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 13 songs; 86 min [7]. Said about its sound: Well-balanced capture with a strong sense of presence [7]

## Around the show

- Roughly two minutes of tuning came before the show opener, Hell In A Bucket [9]
- Reviewer's second show of a senior-year spring break tour; watched from the hallway, noticing the unfinished ceiling with pipes and vents [10]
- Reviewer attended as a 15-year-old Connecticut kid; it was their first Dead show [15]
- Reviewer attended all three shows of the Hartford run [17]
- Jerry lost his voice this night but compensated with the Louie Louie [18]
- The hotel was attached to the Hartford venue [18]
- Jerry's voice is stronger here, and his regained energy carries into the following Worcester show [8]
- Late-80s shows had more goofy songs and flew off the cliff less than early Brent years [16]
- 1988 was overall flat compared with the resurgence of 1987 and the creative peaks of 1989 [17]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1988-04-05.sbd.miller.91234.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (TDK SA-X90) D [1]. Also: Unknown mics to PCM to DAT to CD; pitch correction help came from Joe B. Jones [1]
- **gd1988-04-05.140331.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.flac1644**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-R90) [2]. Also: Three sets of masters were combined to make the show complete; this file set is 16 bit [2]
- **gd1988-04-05.nak300.carpenter.andrewf.90054.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Ted Carpenter; transferred by Andrew F; source: Namamichi CM300's w/CP4 shotguns > Sony TC-D5M > Maxell MX-90's, with no Dolby. Mics on stand in OTS. [4]. Also: Patches from shnid 10073 were added in Bird Song twice and in Space; SoundForge and TLH were used [4]
- **gd88-04-05.aud.painoman.10073.sbeok.shnf**: source: AUD>PCM>CD (Possible Matrix, Healy-FM or one damn good audience recording!) [5]
- **gd1988-04-05.138196.Schoeps.Ammons.set2.t-flac16**: taped by Unknown; transferred by John Ammons and Joe Noel; source: flac16/48kHz ; Set 2 Unknown taper: Schoeps CMC54 at 110 degrees ORTF > Neumann PS > Sony D10 Pro; mics on 8 foot stand 1st row behind soundboard; John Ammons [7]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Robbi Cohn: [1988-04-04 Hartford Civic Center, Hartford, CT, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1988-04-04-hartford-civic-center-hartford-ct-usa/) [21]
- Poster by Robbi Cohn: [1988-04-04 Hartford Civic Center, Hartford, CT, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1988-04-04-hartford-civic-center-hartford-ct-usa/) [22]
